gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: The filter shape uses 833 bits; ceil(833 / 64) = 14 longs are needed to represent the bit map.
ADDED i2: Build a shape where both the number of hash functions and the number of bits are 833.
ADDED i3: Create an empty sparse bloom filter backed by that shape.
ADDED i4: Create a hasher with a specific initial value and increment, then populate the filter.
ADDED i5: The bit-map array packs the 833 bit positions into 64-bit longs: ceil(833/64) = 14.
